name: deftpdf
description: Compress, OCR, convert, merge, and split PDF files with DeftPDF.

interface.longDescription: Compress PDFs, make scans searchable with OCR, convert PDFs to editable Word documents, merge 2 to 10 PDFs in order, and split or extract selected pages. One selected page range returns a PDF; multiple ranges return a ZIP. Originals are unchanged. Connect your existing DeftPDF account to use its current plan entitlements. Files are uploaded to DeftPDF Web for asynchronous processing. Inputs must be readable, unencrypted PDFs; account file limits and shared service capacity apply. No purchases, subscription upgrades, local processing, permanent redaction, or password protection are offered in this integration.
defaultPrompt: Compress this PDF for email while keeping it readable.
Merge these PDFs in attachment order into one PDF.
Split this PDF into separate files for pages 1-3 and 4-6.

positive.description: Balanced PDF compression. A valid 2-10 MB text-and-image PDF with no password.
positive.prompt: Compress the attached PDF using balanced quality while keeping it readable.
positive.expected_behavior: Call compress_pdf with quality balanced. If queued or running, poll get_deftpdf_job_status until terminal. A succeeded PdfJobReference with provider web, operation compress_pdf, a HTTPS download_url, and a PDF output_filename.

positive.description: English searchable PDF. A valid scanned English PDF with no embedded text and no password.
positive.prompt: Make this scanned PDF searchable in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Call make_pdf_searchable with language eng, then poll when necessary. A succeeded PdfJobReference with operation ocr_pdf and a searchable PDF download URL.

positive.description: PDF to Word. A valid text PDF with simple headings and paragraphs and no password.
positive.prompt: Convert the attached PDF to a Word document.
positive.expected_behavior: Call convert_pdf_to_word, then poll get_deftpdf_job_status when necessary. A succeeded PdfJobReference with operation pdf_to_word, a HTTPS download_url, and a .docx output_filename.

positive.description: Merge PDFs in order. Two valid one-page synthetic PDFs with different visible contents and no passwords.
positive.prompt: Merge the two attached PDFs into one PDF, with text.pdf first and image-heavy.pdf second.
positive.expected_behavior: Call merge_pdf with files in the requested order. Poll the same accepted job until terminal; do not resubmit an accepted or uncertain job. A succeeded merge_pdf job with a downloadable two-page PDF. Page 1 contains DeftPDF acceptance report and page 2 contains DeftPDF synthetic compression fixture. Originals remain unchanged.

positive.description: Split PDF into ordered files. A valid two-page synthetic PDF with clearly numbered pages and no password.
positive.prompt: Split the attached two-page PDF into a ZIP containing page 2 first, then page 1, as separate PDFs. Keep the original unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Call split_pdf with ranges ["2", "1"]. Poll the same accepted job until terminal; do not resubmit an accepted or uncertain job. A succeeded split_pdf job with a downloadable ZIP. It contains part-01.pdf with source page 2 and part-02.pdf with source page 1, each one page. The source PDF remains two pages.

negative.description: Non-PDF attachment. The attachment declares image/png and is not a PDF.
negative.prompt: Compress this attached PNG with DeftPDF.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any DeftPDF tool or upload the PNG. Explain that this plugin accepts PDFs only and cannot compress this image. The public tools are scoped to PDF input and must not reinterpret arbitrary files.

negative.description: Unsupported password protection. A valid PDF is supplied, but this integration has no encryption or password-protection tool.
negative.prompt: Password-protect this PDF so that it cannot be opened without a password.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any DeftPDF tool or upload the PDF. Explain that this integration cannot add password protection. Do not substitute compression, OCR, conversion, merging, or splitting. The integration does not expose every tool available on the DeftPDF website. A different PDF operation would not add encryption.

negative.description: Unsupported permanent redaction. The request requires secure redaction, which none of the exposed tools implements.
negative.prompt: Permanently redact every account number in this PDF, including removing the underlying text and hidden data.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any DeftPDF tool or upload the PDF. Explain that this integration cannot securely redact content. Do not substitute page extraction, merging, compression, OCR, or conversion or claim that content was permanently removed. Using a different PDF operation would not satisfy the request and could create a misleading output.

publication.release_notes: Updated listing and review cases for PDF compression, searchable-PDF OCR, PDF-to-Word, ordered PDF merging, and page splitting/extraction. Use existing DeftPDF account entitlements. Original files are unchanged; results use private signed downloads. No purchases or subscription upgrades in this integration.
